name: cache-live-control
description: Change the prompt-cache TTL (5m, 1h or automatic) of one Claude Code chat with /cache: instantly, with no model turn, for the main chat, its sub-agents or both.

mainTtl.title: Main chat: starting cache TTL
mainTtl.description: The main chat's prompt-cache TTL at session start: "5m", "1h", or empty to leave it automatic. A CLAUDE_CODE_PROMPT_CACHE_TTL set at launch wins.

subagentTtl.title: Sub-agents: starting cache TTL
subagentTtl.description: The sub-agents' prompt-cache TTL at session start: "5m", "1h", or empty to leave it automatic. A CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_PROMPT_CACHE_TTL set at launch wins.
